article: Troubleshooting Temporary DNS Resolution Failures in WSL
scope: Compared the full Japanese article and twelve translations, tested commands in documented contexts, removed obsolete Ubuntu Focal example and public DNS override, and aligned guidance with current WSL DNS tunneling and VPN documentation.
findings: Removed the duplicate future date and retained the original 2024-03-31 date; set lastmod to 2026-11-24.
Removed the obsolete hard-coded Google Public DNS workaround and stale Focal/HTTP error screenshot.
Added separate Windows and WSL DNS checks, WSL update and restart steps, DNS tunneling guidance for current supported systems, and VPN/firewall escalation.
Clarified that resolver overrides should not be the first step because public DNS can conflict with VPN or organization policies.
